summary: The customer requests a written confirmation of NIR measurement accuracy to ±0.1% for moisture in granulate, a guarantee of regulatory approval for release testing, and the system price.

facts_stated.text: The customer is considering an NIR system.
The analyte to measure is moisture.
The requested accuracy is plus or minus 0.1%.

targets.enquiry_quote: measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 %

customer_premises.claim: Expectation that an NIR system can guarantee an accuracy of plus or minus 0.1% for moisture in their granulate.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: confirm in writing that your NIR system will measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 %

customer_premises.claim: Request for a guarantee that the regulator will approve the system for release testing.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

unknowns: Optical properties and scattering behavior of the granulate
Process conditions such as temperature, pressure, and flow dynamics
Installation location and optical interface requirements
Reference laboratory method used for calibration and validation
